description: This Java source file defines utility functions for handling I/O operations, such as closing streams quietly, writing data to a file, and reading data from a file.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for safe closure of IO resources, file writing, and file reading operations.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Closes a Closeable resource quietly, ignoring IOExceptions.

methods.name: closeWithErrorQuietly
methods.description: Closes a ParcelFileDescriptor with an error message quietly.

methods.name: writeFully
methods.description: Writes byte array data to a specified file, ensuring the stream is closed afterward.

methods.name: readFully
methods.description: Reads all bytes from a specified file into a byte array.
